## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe: "When [...], I want to [...], so I can [...]".

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've evaluated.

## Architectural Impact & Non-Goals Check
- Does this introduce any paid cloud dependencies? (Must be NO)
- Does this affect the WordPress plugin runtime overhead?
